explanation: Electric toasters were on sale by 1909, so early toast was cut by hand. Machine-sliced bread arrived in 1928 in Chillicothe, Missouri, cut by Otto Rohwedder's slicer.

claims.text: Electric toasters were on sale by 1909.
Bread sliced by machine was first sold in 1928, in Chillicothe, Missouri, using Otto Rohwedder's slicing machine.
Before machine-sliced bread, people toasted bread they had sliced by hand.
